text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick logistics Q — KudoBoxes arrive Thurs. We need pickup plan for SF, NYC, and remote kits. Anyone free to help coordinate distribution?
Jordan (Events): I can run SF pickup. Will need 2 volunteers at 11am for lobby check-in. @Owen can we use the loading bay?
Owen (Facilities): Loading bay reserved 10:30–12:30. I'll arrange dolly and cart. Please send final count by Wednesday EOD.
Tara (Logistics): I'll coordinate courier for NYC and the Remote kit mailing. Need accurate mailing list + preferred courier (UPS/FEDEX).
Maya (People Ops): Here is the pickup tracker: https://company.sheets/kudobox-pickup — pls fill office counts. Also note we have 30 extra kits for surprise drop.
Jordan (Events): Volunteers: @Lydia can you approve the $150 for coffee/snacks? :coffee: 
Lydia (Finance): Approved $150. Please add receipts to expense folder. Also confirm the kit unit cost so I can reconcile.
Maya (People Ops): Unit cost = $12.50 / kit. Shipping estimate NYC = $90 (courier). Remote mail ~ $6/kit.
Tara (Logistics): For remote, I'll batch labels. Can someone confirm the deadline to print? I can print up to 200 labels Thurs morning.
Maya (People Ops): Deadline to finalize list = Wed 5pm PST. After that we lock counts and start packing.
Jordan (Events): Packing plan for SF: 2 stations — station A (name verification + sticker), station B (hand out + quick selfie wall). We need 2 clipboards, 4 pens.
Owen (Facilities): I'll leave 4 pens & 2 clipboards at station. Also temp badge scanner available if you want check-in logs.
Maya (People Ops): Volunteer sign-up: Jordan (lead), Nora (events), Sam (ops), Li (eng). @kudos-bot will post reminders.
kudos-bot: Reminder scheduled — KudoBox pickup Thurs 11:00am SF lobby. Volunteers, please arrive 10:30am.
Lydia (Finance): Small ask — can we tag the 30 extra kits as 'floating kudos' so managers can request? Need approval flow.
Maya (People Ops): Approved. Create a simple form: 3 fields (manager name, reason, number requested). I'll add to the tracker.
Tara (Logistics): Last note — we have 3 folks with dietary prefs in the kit (no nuts). Jordan please ensure label 'nut-free' on those.
Jordan (Events): Got it. I'll flag those kits and add a bright sticker.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks team! I'll post final checklist tomorrow morning. :tada:
